user.title: SmartHus
user.description: Smart control of solar, battery, EV charger and heat pump based on electricity prices. Devices are added afterwards under Configure.

prices.title: Electricity price and tariffs
prices.description: Choose Strømligning if the Strømligning integration is installed. The actual price from the customer's plan is then used, and the tariffs below are only a fallback. Otherwise SmartHus calculates the price from the Energi Data Service spot price and the tariffs below (DKK/kWh excl. VAT, winter = October–March). The sale price is the spot price (from Strømligning, otherwise Energi Data Service) minus the sale deduction, excl. VAT.

battery.title: Battery / inverter
battery.description:
Works with any inverter/battery that can be controlled through a select or input_select entity. Pick the entity that switches the operating mode and type the exact option names.

**Charge from grid**: mode that charges from the grid.
**Discharge**: mode that sells/discharges to the grid in the most expensive hours.
**Normal**: regular self-consumption.

If your inverter only has switches, create an input_select with three options and an automation that applies the choice.

The fields are prefilled with SigEnergy names as an example – change them to match your inverter.

data_description.house_energy_sensor: Pick an increasing energy meter (kWh) measuring the house consumption – e.g. from the inverter, a P1 meter or an electricity meter. 'Grid import' works too, but then battery charging from the grid is included and the reserve gets a little too large. SmartHus learns the hourly consumption from the last 7 days (weekdays and weekends separately) and keeps enough energy in the battery to cover the house until power is cheap again. Only the surplus is sold. EV consumption is subtracted if the car has an energy meter. Requires long-term statistics (if the sensor is in the Energy dashboard it has them). The reserve is used after 2 days of history.
data_description.battery_mode_entity: E.g. select.inverter_work_mode or an input_select you created.
data_description.battery_soc_sensor: Battery level in %. Used for min/max levels and the reserve.

solar.title: Solar
solar.description: Used for savings and to limit export when the sale price is negative.

data.solar_forecast_sensor: Solar forecast: remaining production today (kWh) – optional

data_description.solar_forecast_sensor: Makes the battery reserve more accurate by subtracting expected solar. Solcast: sensor.solcast_pv_forecast_forecast_remaining_today. Forecast.Solar: sensor.energy_production_today_remaining. Without a forecast, solar is assumed not to cover any house consumption – the cautious choice.

ev.title: EVs
ev.description: Choose an EV to edit it, or add a new one. Tick 'Remove' to delete the selected car.

hotwater.title: Hot water
hotwater.description: A switch is turned on in the cheapest continuous period of the day. For a water_heater or climate entity the temperature is raised instead.

heating.title: Heating / heat pump
heating.description: The temperature is raised in the cheapest hours and lowered in the most expensive.
